report.summary: Patient P-D010 (Gregory Nowak, DOB 1971-09-08, Chicago, IL 60656, tract 17031100500) was screened for food needs on 2026-10-21 and answered "never true" to both food-worry and food-ran-out questions, indicating no current food insecurity identified. Coverage is commercial Employer PPO with no transport benefit. Below are community food resources available in the area. Tract profile: low food-insecurity measure (9.7), no USDA low-income/low-access flags; transit access is limited (1 stop within 800m, 3.6% of households no vehicle).
